name: Trident-Studio
description: A self-hosted slicer with a web UI. Trident Studio (Trident for short) runs OrcaSlicer's slicing engine headless in Docker, so you can upload a model, pick a printer and material, preview the G-code layer by layer, and download it or send it straight to a Moonraker or OctoPrint printer, from any browser or phone. OrcaSlicer's full printer and filament library is built in (70+ vendors), you can import your own profiles, and it handles multi-material and tool-changer printers (for example the Snapmaker U1), multi-plate 3MF files with object picking, copies and positioning. It also slices for resin (MSLA) printers, with 150+ printers and a library of published resin settings, and as a bonus supports belt (conveyor) printers such as the IdeaFormer IR3 V2. Built on OrcaSlicer (AGPL-3.0); the patched fork's source is linked from the app's /source page.
